title: Norse Library
heading: A reading room for the curious.
description: Explore the plans for the Norse Library: books, museums, archaeology, sagas and Eddas, with a focus on useful context and traceable sources.
intro: The Norse Library is being prepared as a guide to books, collections and sources. It is not yet a searchable catalogue or a collection of full texts.

sections.heading: Books & scholarship
paragraphs: The planned reading guides will give each work context: who wrote it, what it covers and where a reader might begin.

sections.heading: Museums & archaeology
paragraphs: A future collection of museum resources and archaeological discoveries will connect readers with the institutions and publications behind them.

sections.heading: Sagas & Eddas
paragraphs: Future guides will identify texts, editions and translators so readers can understand which version they are reading. Full-text readers and translations are planned for a later stage.

sections.heading: Help shape the shelves
paragraphs: Recommend a book, a museum collection or a source through the contact page. Include its title, author or institution, and a link where available.
